consent.privacyNotice: By submitting your contact details, you consent to receive communications from Anytime Fitness India and its independently owned and operated franchisees via phone calls, SMS, WhatsApp, and email regarding memberships and promotional offers, in accordance with applicable regulations. You may opt out of such communications at any time. Membership rates, services, and offers may vary by location and are subject to club-specific terms and conditions. Further, in clicking "Submit", I agree to accept the Terms & Conditions, Privacy Notice, and Text Messaging Terms, and attest that I am 18 years of age or older.
